## Highlights

- Card Payments and other Transfers now count in Expenses at the cash that left the source account, in your Base Currency. Before, paying a card in another currency could inflate Expenses. Existing Transfers are repaired automatically on first load, and when neither account is in your Base Currency, the Transfer form asks for a base exchange rate.
- Accounts already in your Base Currency always count at their face amount in Stats, so stale conversions from an earlier Base Currency no longer leak into totals, the Accumulated strip or category bars.
- The Base Currency locks while movements exist, so past figures can't silently change meaning.
- The month selector on Movements and Stats lists the months with data in the selected year, and switching to a past year opens its latest month with data.
- Payment Categories follow the active Language: switching between English and Spanish renames them, and a Restore ends in the restored Language.
- Restore now repairs old Backups the same way an app update does: it links cards to their Payment Categories, fixes movement dates and keeps the right year. The quick action and the Settings backup card share one Restore flow.
- Deleting an account, card or category in Settings shares one confirmation flow and the same controls on every row.
- Complete English and Spanish for all new copy.
